data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew language, Japha means 'God is Healing'. In the Bible, Japha is the name of a son born to Athaliah, the wicked queen of Judah, who was killed during the reign of Josiah. The name symbolizes the hope and healing that can come even in the midst of darkness and adversity. The name Japha carries the meaning “God is Healing” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Japha usually hope their child will grow to embody god is healing and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Japha total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
